name: Superhuman OG card — gradient split with floating AI card by superhuman.com
description: A 1200×630 social card built on a 55/45 split: the left half is a saturated crimson-to-indigo gradient field carrying a white rounded app icon, an oversized letterspaced uppercase wordmark and a light two-line subhead, all clustered on the vertical centre line; the right half is a product screenshot that bleeds off the top and right edges, giving the flat canvas depth. Hierarchy reads icon → wordmark → subhead on the left, while the floating AI popover card — with its red diff text '14 months. 16 months.' — is the focal detail on the right. The palette is strictly three-tone (brand red, deep blue, white), with the screenshot rendered at believable small type sizes so the UI reads as real software rather than an illustration.
